title: Pairing through a binary extension field
statement: Let $\ell$ be a nonzero integer, and let $d$ be a nonnegative integer. Use a basis of the degree-$\ell$ binary extension field to encode its elements as binary vectors of length $\ell$. For $\gamma\in\bbr_2^d$, a family $a_0,\ldots,a_{d-1}$ in that field, and an element $s$ of the field, the dot product of $\gamma$ with the vector whose $i$th coordinate pairs the encodings of $a_i$ and $s$ equals the dot product of the encodings of $\sum_{i=0}^{d-1}\gamma_i a_i$ and $s$.
hypotheses_covered: A family of $d$ elements of the degree-$\ell$ binary extension field
